name: safety-governance
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when trust-ladder / budget enforcement moves into a different layer than a project-local central config (config.json) consulted at tick entry, or when the config schema reaches its next breaking major (3.0.0).
spec_change_reason: Add the additive issue_filter config knob (schema 2.6.0 -> 2.7.0): an optional PULL-stage filter narrowing WHICH open GitHub issues work-intake pulls, an object {labels: <DNF-List[List[str]]>, title_pattern: <regex-or-null>}. Default {labels: [], title_pattern: null} = NO filter (pull all open issues; non-breaking, opt-in). Added issue_filter to DEFAULT_GOVERNANCE + the _overlay backfill, and the pure accessor issue_filter(config) that normalizes (flat-list sugar -> single AND-group; List[List[str]] passthrough; absent/null/[] -> no-filter) and validates (ValueError on non-string label, empty-string label, empty inner group, or non-compilable title_pattern). spec.md/contract.md/CHANGELOG.md updated.
spec_no_change_reason: Phase 2 spec (configure writer flags, --preflight, --describe stage ordering, --setup onboarding) was committed to docs/spec.md prior to this cycle; this cycle implements code+tests for the already-committed spec. Schema unchanged (2.7.0).
